# scimagR ![scimagR logo](reference/figures/logo-with-name.png)

The building blocks of a longitudinal MRI and CT analysis in spinal cord
injury (SCI) research: R wrappers for the Spinal Cord Toolbox (SCT) and
DICOM tools, SCI-specific clinical metrics, an imaging registry,
quality-control logs, plots, and a planner that lists the processing
steps.

## Installation

Install from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("cttir/scimagR")
```

## Prerequisites

The wrappers for image processing need the following external tools.
They are optional: the metrics, registry, quality-control and plotting
functions work without them.

| Tool | Version | Purpose |
|----|----|----|
| [Spinal Cord Toolbox](https://spinalcordtoolbox.com) | \>= 6.4 (6.x and 7.x) | Segmentation, labelling, parameter extraction |
| [dcm2niix](https://github.com/rordenlab/dcm2niix) | any | DICOM to NIfTI conversion |
| Python 3 + pydicom | any | DICOM metadata extraction & anonymisation |

Verify installation:

``` r

library(scimagR)
check_sct()
check_dcm2niix()
check_pydicom()
```

## Quick Start

``` r

library(scimagR)

# 1. Create a new project
sci_create_project(
  "~/projects/my-sci-study",
  title = "Cervical SCI Longitudinal MRI",
  author = "Your Name"
)

# 2. Place DICOMs in data/raw/dicom/, fill registry CSVs

# 3. Plan the processing steps; each row names the function to run
sci_run_pipeline("~/projects/my-sci-study")

# 4. Run those functions, then see which outputs exist
sci_pipeline_status("~/projects/my-sci-study")
```

[`sci_run_pipeline()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sci_run_pipeline.md)
is a planner: it does not run the external tools and reports every step
as `"pending"`. The steps are run with the functions it names, for
example
[`sct_segment_sc()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sct_segment_sc.md);
[`sci_pipeline_status()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sci_pipeline_status.md)
shows which outputs exist.

## Modules

| Module | Key Functions | Description |
|----|----|----|
| **SCT Interface** | [`sct_segment_sc()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sct_segment_sc.md), [`sct_segment_lesion()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sct_segment_lesion.md), [`sct_label_vertebrae()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sct_label_vertebrae.md) | Wrappers for SCT segmentation, labelling, QC and morphometry (SCT 6 and 7) |
| **DICOM Tools** | [`extract_dicom_metadata()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/extract_dicom_metadata.md), [`anonymize_dicom()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/anonymize_dicom.md), [`convert_dcm2niix()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/convert_dcm2niix.md) | Metadata extraction, anonymisation, conversion |
| **SCI Metrics** | [`compute_mscc()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/compute_mscc.md), [`compute_compression_ratio()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/compute_compression_ratio.md), [`classify_phase()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/classify_phase.md) | Domain-specific clinical measures |
| **Registry** | [`create_registry()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/create_registry.md), [`validate_registry()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/validate_registry.md), [`coverage_matrix()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/coverage_matrix.md) | Structured time-point tracking |
| **QC System** | [`filter_evaluable()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/filter_evaluable.md), [`log_exclusion()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/log_exclusion.md), [`integrity_summary()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/integrity_summary.md) | Artefact grading and exclusion tracking |
| **Visualisation** | [`theme_sci()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/theme_sci.md), [`scale_colour_phase()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/scale_phase.md), [`plot_violin_box()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/plot_violin_box.md) | Publication-ready figures |
| **Pipeline** | [`sci_run_pipeline()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sci_run_pipeline.md), [`sci_pipeline_status()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sci_pipeline_status.md) | Step plan and output status |
| **Scaffold** | [`sci_create_project()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sci_create_project.md) | Workflowr project setup |

## Use of LLM tools

Where applicable, LLM tools were used for narrowly defined,
non-authorial tasks: copyediting, prose refinement, Markdown/LaTeX
formatting, boilerplate scaffolding (such as CI configurations and build
scripts), and code refactoring. Tools included [Chat
AI](https://kisski.gwdg.de/leistungen/2-02-llm-service/), the KISSKI
(GWDG) service, and self-hosted **Mistral Small (24B, Apache-2.0)**
served through a local **vLLM architecture** on an Ubuntu Linux
workstation with Intel processors and NVIDIA GPUs. Self-hosted use also
includes models that were further trained (fine-tuned) or weight-edited
in-house for specific tasks. All self-hosted models ran locally, with no
data sent to third parties.

All scientific claims, methodological choices, analyses, interpretations
and conclusions remain the authors’ own. Where applicable, LLM-generated
material must be reviewed and revised before inclusion, and references
must be verified against their DOI, arXiv ID or ISBN.

Local software setup: vLLM with Python/PyTorch, plus R and RStudio.

## Branding

Editable R artwork and regeneration instructions are in
[tools/branding](https://github.com/CTTIR/scimagR/blob/main/tools/branding/README.md).

# Package index

## Spinal Cord Toolbox

Wrappers for SCT command-line tools (needs SCT 6.4 or later).

- [`check_sct()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/check_sct.md)
  : Check Spinal Cord Toolbox Availability
- [`sct_segment_sc()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sct_segment_sc.md)
  : Segment Spinal Cord
- [`sct_segment_lesion()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sct_segment_lesion.md)
  : Segment SCI Lesion
- [`sct_label_vertebrae()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sct_label_vertebrae.md)
  : Label Vertebral Levels
- [`sct_analyze_lesion()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sct_analyze_lesion.md)
  : Extract Lesion Parameters
- [`sct_process_segmentation()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sct_process_segmentation.md)
  : Extract Morphometric Parameters
- [`sct_generate_qc()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/sct_generate_qc.md)
  : Generate SCT Quality Control Report

## DICOM tools

Metadata extraction, anonymisation and NIfTI conversion (needs ‘pydicom’
or ‘dcm2niix’).

- [`check_pydicom()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/check_pydicom.md)
  : Check pydicom Availability
- [`check_dcm2niix()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/check_dcm2niix.md)
  : Check dcm2niix Availability
- [`extract_dicom_metadata()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/extract_dicom_metadata.md)
  : Extract DICOM Header Metadata
- [`anonymize_dicom()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/anonymize_dicom.md)
  : Anonymise DICOM Files
- [`convert_dcm2niix()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/convert_dcm2niix.md)
  : Convert DICOM to NIfTI
- [`convert_batch()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/convert_batch.md)
  : Batch Convert DICOM to NIfTI

## SCI metrics

- [`compute_mscc()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/compute_mscc.md)
  : Compute Maximum Spinal Cord Compression (MSCC)
- [`compute_compression_ratio()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/compute_compression_ratio.md)
  : Compute Spinal Cord Compression Ratio
- [`compute_csa_ratio()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/compute_csa_ratio.md)
  : Compute Cross-Sectional Area Ratio
- [`classify_phase()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/classify_phase.md)
  : Classify SCI Phase Based on Days Post Trauma
- [`classify_artifact()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/classify_artifact.md)
  : Classify MRI Artefact Grade

## Imaging registry

- [`create_registry()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/create_registry.md)
  : Create an Imaging Registry from DICOM Metadata
- [`validate_registry()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/validate_registry.md)
  : Validate an Imaging Registry
- [`coverage_matrix()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/coverage_matrix.md)
  : Create a Modality Coverage Matrix
- [`plot_coverage()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/plot_coverage.md)
  : Plot Modality Coverage Matrix

- [`integrity_summary()`](https://cttir.github.io/scimagR/reference/integrity_summary.md)
  : Print Data Integrity Summary

  : Modality Colour Palette
